text: Good job! Seeds get thirsty. Tap each seed to give it water.
Now the sunshine and water will help them grow. Watch them get big!
When you see an orange carrot, tap it to pick it.
Yummy carrots! You know who LOVES carrots? Buttercup the pony!
She lives in the pony field, by the red barn.
The chickens are laying eggs! Can you find 3 eggs in the chicken coop?
Wonderful! Take the eggs to Mr. Hops. His market is down the road.
Tap the strawberry seeds at the bottom. Then plant them in the dirt and water them!
Mmm, sweet strawberries! Oh! I just remembered something.
Unicorns LOVE flower crowns. Can you pick 5 flowers in the meadow?
The meadow is at the end of the road, past the big pond.
What pretty flowers! Bring them to Grandma.
The rainbow broke into 7 rainbow stars. They fell all over Sparkle Valley.
If we find all 7, the rainbow will come back! I'll come with you!
Follow the yellow arrow to find the stars!
You found them ALL! Let's put them on the Wishing Stone in my magic garden!
THE END! But the fun keeps going!
Grow food and sell it to Mr. Hops. Then buy fun things for your farm, like a real castle!
Wow! You bought EVERYTHING! You're a super farmer!
Hello, my sweetheart! I'm so happy you're here!
A long time ago, a big beautiful rainbow shined over Sparkle Valley. And a magic unicorn lived here too!
But one stormy night, the rainbow broke into pieces. The unicorn got sad and went away to hide.
Maybe if we take good care of the farm and make lots of friends, the magic will come back!
Let's start by planting some carrots. Here are some carrot seeds!
Tap the brown dirt to plant a seed.
Ooh, what pretty flowers! Let me make them into a flower crown...
Twist, twist, twist... Ta-da! A flower crown!
Last night, I saw sparkly hoof prints by the magic gate. Here is the key!
The magic gate is at the end of the bottom road. Go find the unicorn!
And bring a strawberry. Unicorns get hungry!
You did it! The rainbow is back! I'm so proud of you!
Neigh! Crunch, crunch... Yum!
Thank you! Will you be my best friend?
I'll follow you everywhere!
Buttercup is your friend now! Tap on her to ride her!
Neigh? I'm hungry! Do you have a carrot?
Hippity hop! Hello there! Are those fresh eggs?
I will buy them! Here are some shiny coins!
And here is something special: strawberry seeds and sunflower seeds!
Come back any time to sell your food. You can buy fun things for your farm!
Hippity hop! Do you have 3 eggs for me?
Hippity hop! My market is not open yet. Come back later!
The magic gate is locked. Maybe Grandma can help later!
Oh! Hello there! Is that a flower crown? For ME?
You put the flower crown on the unicorn. She looks so pretty!
Thank you! My name is Stardust. I used to sparkle and shine.
But when the rainbow broke, I lost my sparkle. And now I'm sooo hungry.
Do you have a strawberry? Strawberries are my favorite!
Mmm! Sweet and yummy! I feel a little bit better already!
I'm so hungry... Can you grow a strawberry for me?
You put the 7 rainbow stars on the Wishing Stone...
Look! Look! The RAINBOW is back! And my sparkle too!
you are the kindest and bravest friend in all of Sparkle Valley!
Thank you for bringing the magic back. I love you!
The Wishing Stone glows with rainbow magic!
This is the Wishing Stone. It looks like something is missing...
The rainbow is back, and everyone in Sparkle Valley is so happy!
But look! A little bluebird is flying this way. It has a letter!
First we need a basket. Mr. Hops makes the best baskets!
He will need 5 carrots. Grow some carrots, then take them to him!
Now we need a big, colorful balloon! I can sew one with 3 sunflowers and 4 flowers.
Tap the sunflower seeds at the bottom. Then plant them and water them!
The balloon is ready! But it needs some magic to fly up to the sky.
I know who has rainbow magic... Stardust! Tap on her!
The balloon is ready to fly! Tap the balloon and let's go!
Hello! Welcome to the Cloud Kingdom! I am Princess Cloudberry.
A big storm blew three of our ponies far away. Twinkle, Peaches, and Puff are lost!
Will you help me find them? Here are some magic seeds: rainbow carrots and cloudberries!
Twinkle is very shy. I think she is hiding in the flower maze.
Plant rainbow carrot seeds in the cloud garden. A little rain cloud will water them!
Oh, look! Peaches is stuck on the little island. The bridge is broken!
Sunflowers have bridge magic. Bring 3 sunflowers to the bridge to fix it!
Only Puff is still lost. He is a baby pony, and he got lost in the fluffy clouds.
Look for sparkly hoofprints. They will show you the way!
You found all of our lost ponies! Thank you, thank you!
They want to live with you, in your very own Pony Village!
You can come back and visit me any time in the Rainbow Balloon.
Welcome home! Your ponies are waiting for you in Pony Village.
Pony Village is down the road, past the market. Your ponies need cozy homes!
Pick up 3 pieces of wood. Then tap the hammer to build a cottage!
What a beautiful Pony Village! Your ponies love their new homes.
Tap on a pony to pet it, feed it, brush it, and play!
Hooray! You rescued the lost ponies and built them a whole village!
Your ponies are your best friends now. More adventures are coming soon!
Ooh, what pretty colors! Snip, snip, sew, sew...
Ta-da! A big rainbow balloon with pretty ribbons!
Hippity hop! Five crunchy carrots! I will make you a strong basket.
Weave, weave, weave... Ta-da! I put the basket next to the farm, by the big road.
I need 5 carrots to make a basket. Grow some more carrots!
A balloon to the pony kingdom? I can help!
Sparkle, sparkle, rainbow magic!
The letter says...
Dear Sparkle Valley friend. High above the rainbow, there is a secret kingdom where magical ponies live.
But a big storm blew some of our ponies far away. Now they are lost! Please come and help us find them.
Love, Princess Cloudberry.
A pony kingdom in the sky! But how can we get all the way up there?
Oh! I know! We can build a Rainbow Balloon!
Oh! Who are you? I am a little bit shy...
I am so hungry. Do you have a rainbow carrot? They are my favorite!
Crunch, crunch! Yummy! You are so kind.
I am not scared anymore. Will you be my friend?
Yay! You fixed the bridge! I am Peaches!
I was stuck here all by myself. Thank you for saving me!
Hi! I am Puff! I was playing hide and seek, and then I got lost!
My tummy is rumbly. Do you have a cloudberry?
Yum, yum! Cloudberries are the best!
Can I come and live with you?
You put the sunflowers on the broken bridge...
Sparkle, sparkle! It turned into a rainbow bridge!
sugarplum
Look! The little bluebird is back. It has another letter!
You came back! Look at my Rain Fountain. It is all dry!
The storm blew its 3 sparkle drops into the fluffy clouds.
Tap a fluffy cloud to look inside. What will you find?
You found all 3 sparkle drops! Let us put them in the Rain Fountain.
A new cloud path! It goes down, past the fluffy clouds, to the Moon Garden.
Walk close to a glowing firefly to catch it!
Hoo hoo! You lit all the lanterns! The Moon Garden is glowing!
Now the moonflowers can grow. Here are some moonflower seeds!
Plant the seeds in the Moon Garden. Drizzle will water them for you!
Listen! Someone is singing a happy song over the rainbow bridge.
Plant strawberries and star oats in a cloud garden. Drizzle will water them!
Now let us bake the cake together! Tap me when you are ready.
Whoosh! Your pony friends flew up to the Party Meadow!
Let's have a Rainbow Race before the party! Go to the starting line!
That race was so fun! Now let us play tag in the flower maze!
Come and find me in the maze. Tag me 3 times!
The party is all ready! Now we need the princess.
Can you bring Princess Cloudberry to the Party Meadow? Shh! Don't tell her!
Moonbeam and Sugarplum want to live in your Pony Village, too!
Fly home and build them cozy cottages. Come back and visit me soon!
Welcome home! What a big adventure!
Moonbeam and Sugarplum need cozy cottages in Pony Village.
You whisper: Please come for a little walk with me, Princess!
A little walk? Oh, how fun! Lead the way!
Dear friend. Thank you for saving Twinkle, Peaches, and Puff!
But oh no! My Rain Fountain stopped working, and the cloud gardens are so thirsty.
And two more ponies are still lost: Moonbeam and Sugarplum. Please come back and help us!
You are already in the Cloud Kingdom! Let us go and find the princess.
Let's fly the Rainbow Balloon to the Cloud Kingdom!
You put the 3 sparkle drops in the Rain Fountain...
Splash! The Rain Fountain is working again!
Look! Something is waking up in the fountain mist...
Yaaawn! Hello! I am Drizzle, the rain cloud of the Cloud Kingdom!
The storm made me so sleepy. Thank you for waking me up!
Now I can water all the cloud gardens for you. Drip, drop!
Thank you, Drizzle! Two of our ponies are still lost. Can you help us find them?
Yes! I will make a new cloud path, down past the fluffy clouds. Look!
Shh! A pony is fast asleep on a little cloud.
Zzz... Zzz...
Hoo hoo! Hello there! I am Hoot, the wise owl of the Moon Garden.
This is Moonbeam. The big storm was so loud, she fell into a very deep sleep.
Only a glowing moonflower can wake her up. And moonflowers need firefly light to grow!
Can you catch 5 fireflies? They will light up the lanterns.
You put the glowing moonflower next to Moonbeam...
It smells so sweet... Look! She is waking up!
Yawn... Good morning! Oh, hello! Did you wake me up with a moonflower?
I was so sleepy after the big storm. Thank you, thank you!
Will you be my friend?
Oh! Hi there! I am Sugarplum!
Shh! Can you keep a secret? I am planning a surprise party for Princess Cloudberry!
But the big storm blew my party cake away. Boo hoo!
Will you help me bake a new one? We need 3 strawberries and 3 star oats.
Here are some star oat seeds!
Yay! Strawberries and star oats! Thank you!
Our cake is perfect! I put it on the party table.
You are the best baker in the whole sky! Will you be my friend, too?
SURPRISE!
Oh my! A surprise party? For ME?
Yes! And friend helped me bake the cake!
My fountain is working, my ponies are safe, and now a party! This is the best day ever!
you are the kindest, bravest friend in the whole sky.
So I have a special present for you. The Rainbow Crown!
You got the Rainbow Crown! Now you are a real hero of the Cloud Kingdom!
Hooray for friend!
Let us eat cake! Yum, yum!
You tagged me 3 times! You are so good at tag!
Wow! You won the Rainbow Race! You are super fast!
You got a gold medal!
Ready? Run through all the rainbow rings!
Hooray! You fixed the Rain Fountain, rescued Moonbeam and Sugarplum, and threw the best party in the sky!
Tap on a pony and press the play button. Each pony has a special game to play with you!
Wow! Five ponies live here now! Your village grew into a Pony Kingdom!
Look at the castle gate, the flags and the rainbow paths!
New decorations are ready! Tap the paint brush to see them.
Hooray! Three ponies live here now! Your Pony Village is a real village!
Look! A flower arch and little stone paths!
You got the Rainbow Crown! You look like a real rainbow princess!
It is in your wardrobe. Tap the dress button any time!
Look! A pretty butterfly is fluttering this way. It is carrying a leaf letter!
A fairy forest! The Rainbow Balloon can take you there. Tap the balloon!
Welcome to the Fairy Forest! Look at all the tall trees and mushrooms!
Hi hi hi! I am Pip, a tiny fairy! Come and meet our queen!
Tap each thorny vine with your magic wand!
Plant golden acorn seeds in the fairy garden. I will water them for you!
Thank you for saving Clover! But look. The thorny vines broke the little fairy houses.
Fairy houses are made from fairy mushrooms. Can you grow 3 fairy mushrooms?
Now let us build the fairy houses! Tap a broken house, and pick the colors you like!
Listen! Somebody is squeaking by the last fairy house!
Let us mix the big-again potion! Tap Button when you are ready.
You are such a good helper! Now we must find baby Glimmer.
I know a secret path! It only opens with the fairy lights game.
Come to the mushroom ring. Watch the mushrooms light up, then tap them in the same order!
You saved Clover, Button, and baby Glimmer! The Fairy Forest is happy again!
Your new friends want to live in your Pony Village. Here is a big bundle of magic wood to build their cottages!
Come back and visit us any time!
Welcome home, sweetie! What a magical adventure!
Your new pony friends need cozy cottages in Pony Village.
Go to Pony Village. Then tap the hammer to build a cottage!
The leaf letter says...
Dear friend. I am Queen Willow, the queen of the Fairy Forest.
A baby unicorn named Glimmer is lost in our forest. And prickly thorn vines tangled up everything!
Please fly your Rainbow Balloon to the Fairy Forest and help us. Love, Queen Willow.
Hello! Thank you for coming all the way to the Fairy Forest!
Here is a magic fairy wand. Tap a thorny vine with it, and the vine will turn into flowers!
And here are some fairy seeds: fairy mushrooms and golden acorns!
I heard a little pony crying behind the thorny vines. Let us go and help!
Oh, thank you! The thorny vines were all around me!
I am Clover. I am sooo hungry. Do you have a golden acorn? They are my favorite!
Crunch, crunch! Yummy! You are my hero!
Will you be my friend?
Three fairy mushrooms! Yay! Now we can build the fairy houses!
Yay! All three fairies have new houses!
Squeak! Squeak! What was that?
Yay! A fairy moved in!
Tap another broken fairy house!
Squeak! Hello! I am Button. Oh no, I am as tiny as a fairy!
Oopsy! That was me! My magic spell went wrong, and it made him teeny tiny!
We can fix it with a big-again potion! Let us mix it together!
Bubble, bubble... POOF!
I am big again! Thank you, thank you!
Can I be your friend and live in your Pony Village?
Oh! Hello... I am Glimmer. I got lost, and now my horn lost its sparkle.
Can you help me get my sparkle back? I need three magic colors. Tap me when you are ready!
Look! My horn is sparkling again! Thank you!
Can I live with you and be your friend?
You did it! You are so good at remembering!
Look! Glowing stepping stones appeared over the stream. It is the secret path!
Hooray! You saved the Fairy Forest and rescued three new pony friends!
Tap a pony and press the play button. Clover, Button, and Glimmer have new games to play with you!
Look! A big shiny bubble is floating this way. There is a bottle inside!
A mermaid princess needs your help! Tap the Rainbow Balloon!
Welcome to Mermaid Lagoon! Look at the sparkly blue sea!
Click, click! Hello! I am Pinch the crab. The princess is waiting for you by her palace!
Tap the bubbles to pop them!
Plant sea grape seeds in the beach garden. Water them, and they will grow!
Now let us fix my palace! We need seashells.
Click, click! I saw lots of seashells on the beach! Let us find 8!
You found 8 seashells! Now tap my broken palace, and let us build it together!
My palace is beautiful again! Thank you!
Listen! Someone is giggling inside the giant clams on the reef.
The clams only open when you find two that are the same. Tap a giant clam to play!
Plant beach melon seeds in the beach garden. Then give a beach melon to Pearl!
One more sea pony is lost, far out in the big blue sea.
Splash the dolphin can take you there. He is waiting at the Dolphin Dock!
You saved Coral, Pearl, and Misty, and you fixed my palace! Hooray!
Your new friends want to live in your Pony Village. Here is a big bundle of magic driftwood to build their cottages!
Come back and swim with us any time!
Welcome home, sweetie! You smell like the sea!
Coral, Pearl, and Misty need cozy cottages in Pony Village.
Pop! The bubble had a message in a bottle!
Dear friend. I am Princess Marina, the mermaid princess of Mermaid Lagoon.
A big storm broke my seashell palace, and three little sea ponies got lost in the waves!
Please fly your Rainbow Balloon to Mermaid Lagoon and help us. Love, Princess Marina.
Hello! I am Princess Marina. Thank you for coming!
The storm broke my seashell palace, and three little sea ponies got lost.
Here are some beach seeds: sea grapes and beach melons!
Listen! I hear a little sea pony on the coral reef. She is stuck inside a giant bubble!
Wheee! Thank you! I was stuck in that big bubble!
I am Coral. I am so hungry. Do you have sea grapes? They are my favorite!
Yum, yum! Sea grapes are the best!
Will you be my friend?
Look! My Seashell Palace is even more beautiful than before!
Click, click! Hooray!
Peekaboo! I am Pearl! I was hiding in the clam because the storm was so loud.
I am a little bit hungry. Do you have a beach melon? It is my favorite!
Mmm! Juicy and sweet! Thank you!
Can I be your friend and come home with you?
You found me! I was lost in the big waves, and I was so scared.
Thank you, Splash! And thank you! Can I come home with you?
Hooray! You fixed the Seashell Palace and rescued three sea ponies!
Tap a pony and press the play button. Coral, Pearl, and Misty have new games to play with you!
Whoosh! Look up! A little shooting star is zooming this way with a letter!
Mother Moon needs your help! The Rainbow Balloon can fly you to Moonlight Meadow. Tap the balloon!
Welcome to Moonlight Meadow! It is always a soft, cozy night here.
Zoom, zoom! I am Zip! Come and meet Mother Moon on Moon Hill!
Nova fell asleep in the dandelion field. Her star is hiding in a fluffy dandelion.
Tap the fluffy dandelions to blow them!
You found Nova's star! Now toss it back up into the sky. Tap the star!
Comet is sleeping by Mirror Lake. His star fell into the water with a big splash!
Tap the lake to scoop it out with a net!
Two stars are home! But the last star broke into little pieces when it fell.
The Wish Windmill can blow the pieces up into the air. But it is broken.
Zoom! Let us fix it! Grow 2 moon melons and 2 dream daisies. I will water them with stardust!
Yay! Now tap the windmill, and let us fix it together!
Whoosh! The Wish Windmill is blowing the star pieces up into the air!
Catch them! Walk to them or tap them!
You caught all the star pieces! They belong to Dusk, the sleepiest star pony.
She is sleeping on Sleepy Hill. Play her a wake-up song on the star bells!
Yawn... What a beautiful song. Hello! I am Dusk.
My star broke into pieces. Can you help me put it back together in the sky? Tap me!
All the stars are shining again, and the star ponies are wide awake. Thank you, little one!
Nova, Comet, and Dusk want to live in your Pony Village. Here is a bundle of moon wood to build their cottages!
Come back and visit any night. Sweet dreams!
Welcome home, sweetie! Did you see the stars? They are so bright tonight!
Nova, Comet, and Dusk need cozy cottages in Pony Village.
Zoom, zoom! Special delivery! A letter from Mother Moon!
Dear little one. I am Mother Moon, and I watch over Moonlight Meadow.
Oh dear. Last night, three stars fell out of the sky! And without their stars, my star ponies are too sleepy to wake up.
Please fly your Rainbow Balloon to Moonlight Meadow and help us. Love, Mother Moon.
Hello, little one. Thank you for coming all the way to Moonlight Meadow.
My star ponies Nova, Comet, and Dusk are fast asleep. They need their stars back in the sky.
Here are some moon seeds: moon melons and dream daisies. Zip will water them with stardust.
There it is! A fallen star!
Yawn... Oh! My star is shining again! I feel so bright and happy!
Thank you! I am Nova. Can I be your friend?
Whoa! I am awake! My star is zooming across the sky again!
Thank you! I am Comet. Can I come and live with you?
Zoom, zoom! Moon melons and dream daisies! Now we can fix the windmill!
Yay! The Wish Windmill is spinning again!
My star is back in the sky, and it is a pony! It is the most beautiful thing I ever saw!
Thank you. Can I be your friend and live with you?
Hooray! You put the stars back in the sky and woke up three star ponies!
Tap a pony and press the play button. Nova, Comet, and Dusk have new games to play with you!
You have helped every land the Rainbow Balloon can fly to. You are a true pony hero!
Once upon a time, a little farmer came to visit Grandma's farm in Sparkle Valley.
Tap on the grass to walk. Tap on things to use them!
Look! There's Grandma. Tap on her to say hi!
Welcome back!
Say hi to Grandma! Tap on her.
Plant 3 carrot seeds. Tap the brown dirt!
Tap the brown dirt next to the house to plant a seed.
Water your seeds. Tap each seed!
See the water drops? Tap the seeds to water them.
Watch the carrots grow, then pick 3!
Carrots need a little time to grow. If a seed has a water drop, tap it to water it!
Give Buttercup the pony a carrot.
Buttercup is in the pony field by the red barn. Tap on her!
Find 3 eggs in the chicken coop.
The chicken coop is next to the farm. Look for white eggs!
Take the eggs to Mr. Hops at the market.
Mr. Hops the bunny has a market at the bottom of the road.
Grow and pick 3 strawberries.
Pick the strawberry seeds at the bottom of the screen. Then plant and water them!
Pick 5 flowers in the meadow.
The flower meadow is at the end of the top road.
Bring the flowers to Grandma.
Go through the magic gate and find the unicorn!
The magic gate is at the end of the bottom road. The unicorn is inside!
Give Stardust a strawberry.
Stardust is hungry. Bring her a strawberry! You can grow more on the farm.
Find the 7 rainbow stars!
Follow the yellow arrow to find the rainbow stars!
Put the stars on the Wishing Stone in the magic garden.
The Wishing Stone is in the magic garden, where you met Stardust.
A bluebird has a letter for you! Tap the bluebird.
Tap the little bluebird to read the letter!
Bring Mr. Hops 5 carrots to make a basket.
Grow 5 carrots, then take them to Mr. Hops at the market.
Bring Grandma 3 sunflowers and 4 flowers for the balloon.
Grow 3 sunflowers on the farm, and pick 4 flowers in the meadow. Then bring them to Grandma.
Ask Stardust to make the balloon fly.
Tap on Stardust the unicorn. She has rainbow magic!
Tap the Rainbow Balloon to fly to the pony kingdom!
The Rainbow Balloon is next to the farm, by the big road. Tap it to fly!
Find Twinkle in the flower maze.
Twinkle is hiding in the flower maze. Look for her in the flowers!
Grow a rainbow carrot and give it to Twinkle.
Plant rainbow carrot seeds in the cloud garden, next to the castle. Then give a rainbow carrot to Twinkle.
Bring 3 sunflowers to fix the broken bridge.
Grow 3 sunflowers in the cloud garden, then tap the broken bridge.
Cross the rainbow bridge and say hi to Peaches.
Walk over the rainbow bridge and tap on Peaches.
Follow the sparkly hoofprints to find Puff.
Follow the sparkly hoofprints in the fluffy clouds to find Puff.
Grow a cloudberry and give it to Puff.
Plant cloudberry seeds in the cloud garden. Then give a cloudberry to Puff.
Fly home to Sparkle Valley in the Rainbow Balloon.
Tap the Rainbow Balloon to fly home.
Build a cottage for each pony in Pony Village.
Pick up 3 pieces of wood in Pony Village. Then tap the hammer to build a cottage!
Play with your ponies and fill up their friendship hearts.
Tap on a pony to pet it, feed it, brush it, and play!
The bluebird has another letter! Tap the bluebird.
Fly the Rainbow Balloon to the Cloud Kingdom.
Find 3 sparkle drops! Tap the fluffy clouds to look inside.
Tap the fluffy clouds to look inside. Follow the arrow!
Put the sparkle drops in the Rain Fountain by the castle.
The Rain Fountain is next to the castle. Tap it!
Follow the new cloud path to the Moon Garden.
Walk down the new cloud path, past the fluffy clouds, to the Moon Garden.
Catch 5 fireflies to light the lanterns.
Walk close to the glowing fireflies to catch them. Each one lights a lantern!
Grow a moonflower and give it to Moonbeam.
Plant moonflower seeds in the Moon Garden. Drizzle will water them. Then give the moonflower to Moonbeam.
Cross the rainbow bridge to the Party Meadow and say hi.
Walk over the rainbow bridge next to the Moon Garden. Then say hi to the pony in the Party Meadow!
Grow 3 strawberries and 3 star oats for the party cake.
Plant strawberry seeds and star oat seeds in a cloud garden. Then bring them to Sugarplum.
Bake the party cake with Sugarplum! Tap on her.
Tap on Sugarplum in the Party Meadow to bake the cake!
Win the Rainbow Race! Go to the starting line.
Go to the starting line in the Party Meadow. Then run through the rainbow rings, one by one!
Play tag with Twinkle in the flower maze. Tag her 3 times!
Twinkle is in the flower maze, by the castle. Walk up close to tag her!
Bring Princess Cloudberry to the Party Meadow. Shh, it is a surprise!
Tap on Princess Cloudberry at the castle. Then walk with her to the Party Meadow!
Build cottages for Moonbeam and Sugarplum in Pony Village.
A butterfly has a leaf letter for you! Tap the butterfly.
Tap the butterfly to read the leaf letter!
Fly the Rainbow Balloon to the Fairy Forest.
Tap the Rainbow Balloon. Then tap the Fairy Forest picture!
Say hello to Queen Willow on her mushroom throne.
Queen Willow is on her mushroom throne. Follow the arrow!
Tap the thorny vines to turn them into flowers!
Tap each thorny vine with your magic wand. Follow the arrow!
Grow a golden acorn and give it to the forest pony.
Plant golden acorn seeds in the fairy garden. Pip will water them! Then give a golden acorn to the pony.
Grow 3 fairy mushrooms for the fairy houses.
Plant fairy mushroom seeds in the fairy garden. Then take 3 fairy mushrooms to the broken fairy houses.
Build 3 fairy houses! Tap a broken house.
Tap a broken fairy house to build it. Pick the colors you like!
Say hi to the teeny tiny pony by the fairy houses.
Tap the teeny tiny pony next to the fairy houses.
Mix the big-again potion! Tap Button to start.
Tap the tiny pony. Then tap the pictures in the recipe, one by one!
Play the fairy lights game at the mushroom ring.
Go to the mushroom ring. Watch the lights, then tap the mushrooms in the same order.
Follow the secret path to find Glimmer.
Walk across the glowing stepping stones to the secret glade.
Give Glimmer the magic colors she asks for. Tap Glimmer.
Tap Glimmer. Then tap the color she asks for!
Tap the Rainbow Balloon and fly home to Sparkle Valley.
Build cottages for Clover, Button, and Glimmer in Pony Village.
Go to Pony Village and tap the hammer to build a cottage.
A big bubble with a bottle inside is floating to you! Tap the bubble.
Tap the big shiny bubble to get the bottle!
Fly the Rainbow Balloon to Mermaid Lagoon.
Tap the Rainbow Balloon. Then tap the Mermaid Lagoon picture!
Say hello to Princess Marina by the broken palace.
Princess Marina is next to her broken palace. Follow the arrow!
Pop the bubbles to free the little sea pony!
Walk onto the coral reef. Then tap the bubbles to pop them!
Grow sea grapes and give them to the little sea pony.
Plant sea grape seeds in the beach garden and water them. Then give sea grapes to the sea pony.
Collect 8 seashells on the beach for the palace.
Walk on the beach and pick up 8 seashells. Follow the arrow!
Build the Seashell Palace! Tap the broken palace.
Tap the broken palace. Then pick the colors and shells you like!
Play the clam game to find who is hiding. Tap a giant clam.
Tap a giant clam on the reef. Then find two that are the same!
Grow a beach melon and give it to Pearl.
Plant beach melon seeds in the beach garden. Then give a beach melon to Pearl.
Ride Splash the dolphin to find the last sea pony! Tap Splash.
Go to the Dolphin Dock and tap Splash. Then move your finger up and down to swim!
Build cottages for Coral, Pearl, and Misty in Pony Village.
A shooting star has a letter for you! Tap the shooting star.
Tap the little shooting star to read the letter!
Fly the Rainbow Balloon to Moonlight Meadow.
Tap the Rainbow Balloon. Then tap the Moonlight Meadow picture!
Say hello to Mother Moon on Moon Hill.
Mother Moon is resting on Moon Hill. Follow the arrow!
Blow the dandelion fluff to find a fallen star. Tap the fluffy dandelions!
Go to the dandelion field. Tap the fluffy dandelions to blow them away!
Toss the fallen star back into the sky! Tap the star.
Tap the fallen star. Then push it up, up, up into the sky!
Scoop Comet's star out of Mirror Lake. Tap the lake.
